motion.name: beacon-breathe

motion.name: hud-sweep
motion.purpose: Single pass of light across a chart plate on arrival. The only plate sweep; no background scan line.

motion.name: chart-draw
motion.purpose: Recharts series draw-in; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: hud-grow / hud-glint
motion.purpose: Meter fill arrival and periodic glint.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All loops removed, entrances skipped, pulse/glint/skeleton scan hidden, seams static; content never depends on an animation finishing.

components.css: .ds-btn-lit{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:40px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:12px;font:600 14px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--accent-ink,#03140d);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8be7c5,#5fc3a0 55%,#2f8a6b);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2),0 8px 22px -10px rgba(95,195,160,.8);transition:box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),filter .3s;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-lit::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 50%,transparent 65%);transform:translateX(-110%);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-lit:hover{filter:brightness(1.06);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2),0 12px 30px -10px rgba(95,195,160,.95)}.ds-btn-lit:hover::after{transform:translateX(110%)}.ds-btn-lit:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99)}.ds-btn-lit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8be7c5;outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-glass{position:relative;isolation:isolate;max-width:320px;padding:16px;border-radius:20px;color:#eef4f1;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.012)),rgba(15,21,20,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(150%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 24px 48px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.ds-glass::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:14px;right:14px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(139,231,197,.55) 50%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(139,231,197,.4)}.ds-glass-head{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-glass h2{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-glass p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#a5b2ad}.ds-chip{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;color:#a8dcc9;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(95,195,160,.3),rgba(95,195,160,.08));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(95,195,160,.4),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 6px 18px -8px rgba(95,195,160,.8)}.ds-fig{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;font-feature-settings:'tnum' 1;color:#1fb380}.ds-glass:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}

components.css: .ds-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;padding:24px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(15,21,20,.6);border:1px solid rgba(95,195,160,.32);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-beacon{position:absolute;z-index:-1;top:-30%;left:-18%;width:78%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(95,195,160,.28),rgba(95,195,160,.06) 45%,transparent 68%);animation:ds-breathe 6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite alternate}.ds-hero-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#a5b2ad;margin-bottom:4px}.ds-reticle{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:8px 16px 10px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(139,231,197,.45);background:radial-gradient(120% 140% at 50% 0%,rgba(95,195,160,.1),transparent 70%)}.ds-reticle i{position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;border:0 solid rgba(139,231,197,.75)}.ds-reticle i[data-c=tl]{top:-3px;left:-3px;border-top-width:1.5px;border-left-width:1.5px}.ds-reticle i[data-c=tr]{top:-3px;right:-3px;border-top-width:1.5px;border-right-width:1.5px}.ds-reticle i[data-c=bl]{bottom:-3px;left:-3px;border-bottom-width:1.5px;border-left-width:1.5px}.ds-reticle i[data-c=br]{bottom:-3px;right:-3px;border-bottom-width:1.5px;border-right-width:1.5px}.ds-hero-fig{font-size:40px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;font-feature-settings:'tnum' 1;color:#eef4f1;text-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(238,244,241,.3),0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}@keyframes ds-breathe{from{transform:scale(.92);opacity:.75}to{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:1}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-beacon{animation:none}}

components.css: .ds-plate{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;width:320px;padding:12px 6px 4px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(0,0,0,.28));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 14px 30px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}.ds-plate::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 12% auto;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(139,231,197,.75),transparent)}.ds-plate::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0 35%,rgba(95,195,160,.12) 50%,transparent 65% 100%);transform:translateX(-100%);animation:ds-sweep 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .15s both;pointer-events:none}.ds-plate i{position:absolute;z-index:2;width:10px;height:10px;border:0 solid rgba(139,231,197,.75)}.ds-plate i[data-c=tl]{top:6px;left:6px;border-top-width:1.5px;border-left-width:1.5px;border-top-left-radius:4px}.ds-plate i[data-c=tr]{top:6px;right:6px;border-top-width:1.5px;border-right-width:1.5px;border-top-right-radius:4px}.ds-plate i[data-c=bl]{bottom:6px;left:6px;border-bottom-width:1.5px;border-left-width:1.5px;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}.ds-plate i[data-c=br]{bottom:6px;right:6px;border-bottom-width:1.5px;border-right-width:1.5px;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}@keyframes ds-sweep{to{transform:translateX(100%)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-plate::after{animation:none;display:none}}

narrative.overview:
Money Hub is a dashboard you read in the dark: smoked glass panels floating over a near-black ground, with pine light leaking from behind them and running along their top edges. The light source is always pine. It drifts in slow fields behind the glass, travels each panel's seam, lights the active nav item, glides under the dock tab, and pools brightest behind the one number that matters on a screen: Safe-to-spend. Everything else sits one step dimmer.

The world is dense but quiet. Panels are frosted and beveled, edges are 1px white-alpha lines, and color is rationed: status hues (green, amber, coral) glow only where they carry meaning, and money out is never painted red. Figures are system sans with tabular digits, so columns of money align digit for digit and nothing pretends to be a display face. Motion is maximal (seams travel, halos turn, fields drift, panels rise into place), and all of it stops under Reduce Motion without hiding a single figure.

This replaces the earlier light/dark "Ledger at Dusk" system entirely. There is no light theme. The flat, light admin card grid is the explicit rejection.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only; one material (smoked glass), one light source (pine).
A single lit hero figure per screen: Safe-to-spend, in a reticle over a beacon.
Green means money in. Red means overdue, shortfall or error. Spending is orange.
System sans, tabular figures, tight tracking on headings.
Maximal ambient and arrival motion, transform-only where it loops, fully off under Reduce Motion.
HUD instrumentation for data: chart plates with corner brackets, lit gradients, readout tooltips, lit meters.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Money-In Green is the only green that carries meaning, and it means money in. Money out stays neutral ink. Red never marks an ordinary outflow; it is reserved for overdue, shortfall, overspent and error states.

rules.name: The Ember Series Rule
rules.body: Spending in charts is Spending Ember (orange), paired against Money-In Green income. A red spending series is wrong.

rules.name: The Status-When-Active Rule
rules.body: Icon chips are pine (or muted neutral) at rest and take caution or alarm hue only while that status is actually active (an overdue count above zero, items to review). A chip that is amber or coral with nothing wrong is lying.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Status hues glow (badge glow, tinted seams, danger beacon) only where they carry a state. Decoration glows pine.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money figure and count uses tabular figures so digits align in columns and figures never jitter when values change.

rules.name: The No Count-Up Rule
rules.body: Figures arrive with a blur-and-tracking settle (`figure-in`), never with counting or interpolated values. The number on screen is always the database's number.

rules.name: The One Lit Hero Rule
rules.body: Exactly one figure per screen is lit: Safe-to-spend on the Dashboard, framed by the reticle (ring of light plus four corner brackets) over a breathing beacon. Secondary headline figures are large but unlit.

rules.name: The Capped Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur never exceeds 20px (glass 20px, readout 14px, scrim 6px). Ambient motion is transform-only on a fixed layer. Both protect phone GPUs.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is one theme. `color-scheme: dark`; no light tokens, no theme switch.

dos: **Do** keep every color on a `:root` token in `web/src/index.css`; components never use raw hex.
**Do** make Safe-to-spend the only lit figure on a screen: emphasis plus reticle plus the panel beacon. Other headline figures use the large, unlit size.
**Do** color money in with Money-In Green (#1fb380) and leave money out in neutral ink; chart spending in Spending Ember (#e2652f).
**Do** keep icon chips pine or muted at rest and switch them to caution or alarm only while that status is active.
**Do** put every chart on a HUD plate with brackets, the lit gradients from the HUD defs, a readout tooltip, and the dotted `2 5` grid.
**Do** use tabular figures for every money value and count.

**Do** give every looping or arrival animation a reduced-motion path: loops removed, entrances skipped, decorative moving layers hidden. Arrival animations start from a near-visible state so content never depends on an animation finishing.
**Do** keep backdrop blur at 20px or less and ambient motion transform-only.
**Do** keep touch targets at 40px or more and money inputs on `inputMode="decimal"` at 16px on phones.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme or light surfaces; the system is dark only.
**Don't** paint money out red. Red is for overdue, shortfall, overspent and error states only.
**Don't** light a second hero figure or put a reticle or beacon on more than one panel per screen.
**Don't** count up, tween or interpolate money values; no money arithmetic in the browser.
**Don't** introduce a custom display or web font; the system sans is a deliberate choice.
**Don't** run a full-screen sweeping scan or radar line across the background. The chart plate's single arrival sweep and the skeleton scan are the only sweeps.
**Don't** move the ambient field or any full-screen layer with anything but transforms; never animate layout properties (top, left, width, height) in a loop.
**Don't** let status hues glow decoratively; amber and coral appear only with an active state.
**Don't** return to the flat, light admin card grid.
